the-poetical-works-of-oliver-wendell-hol: The second volume of Holmes' collected poems gathers additional pieces from 1837 to 1848 — the Autocrat of the Breakfast Table in his brilliant prime. Wit, patriotism, and gentle satire mark these verses on American life. Boston's beloved doctor-poet at his most sparkling.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-acta-pilati: This 1913 reference article on the Acta Pilati — the apocryphal Gospel of Nicodemus, Pilate's supposed report. George Reid sorts its legends from history. Christ's descent into hell fills its pages. Pious fiction of the early Church.
